title: Past Perfect Continuous
intro:
Past perfect continuous: had been + kata kerja -ing. Untuk kegiatan yang sudah berlangsung beberapa lama sebelum kejadian lampau lainnya.
They had been waiting for an hour.
She had been working all morning.

exercises.question: They ___ for an hour when the bus came.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya had been + kata kerja -ing: had been waiting.

exercises.question: She ___ all morning before she rested.
exercises.explanation: Had been, bukan had being. Semua subjek memakai had.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past perfect continuous
exercises.sentence: I ___ (study) for two hours before dinner.
exercises.explanation: Had been + kata kerja -ing: had been studying.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past perfect continuous
exercises.explanation: Had been + running. Kata kerja run menggandakan huruf n sebelum -ing.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.answer: We had been cooking for two hours
exercises.explanation: Subjek + had been + kata kerja -ing + for + lama waktu.

exercises.prompt: Match each tense to its formula
exercises.explanation: Past continuous memakai was/were, past perfect memakai had + bentuk ketiga, dan past perfect continuous menggabungkan keduanya menjadi had been + -ing.

exercises.question: Pick the correct sentence.
options: She had been reading for an hour.
She has been read for an hour.
She had been read for an hour.
exercises.answer: She had been reading for an hour.
exercises.explanation: Setelah had been, kata kerja harus berakhiran -ing: reading.

exercises.question: He had been living there ___ 2019.
exercises.explanation: Since dipakai untuk titik mulai seperti tahun 2019. For dipakai untuk lama waktu.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about something you had been doing before you slept.
exercises.modelAnswer: I had been studying for two hours before I slept.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan had been + kata kerja -ing, misalnya 'I had been studying for two hours before I slept.'
